observer: Analysis uses selected RouteViews collectors only. Other observation points may yield different results.
add_path: ADD-PATH identity is not preserved. Multiple paths from the same peer for the same prefix may be collapsed.
manual_mappings: Participant-to-ASN mapping is manually supplied in the reviewed manifest. It is not derived automatically from ticket text.
archive_parser: Parsed via bgpkit-parser. Parser limitations apply.
unsupported_conclusions: Physical-layer attribution (e.g. 'the NYIIX circuit failed') is not supported by control-plane observations alone.
Global reachability cannot be asserted from a limited set of observer streams.
